title: About Us
detailHtml:
Our Story

In late 2002, I was laid off from my job as an IT and project manager on Wall Street. I was a single father at the time, and I needed steady work fast to support my daughter — but after a layoff like that, jobs weren’t easy to find. So I got my taxi license in New York City and started driving.

It didn’t take long before I realized I could do more than wait for dispatched fares. Years before rideshare apps existed, I taught myself how search engines worked and how to bring in my own customers directly — a lot of trial and error, long before most small business owners had ever heard the term “SEO.” That self-taught approach grew into a real business serving New York City, Long Island, Westchester County, and parts of Connecticut and New York — areas we still serve today through trusted local partners.

After COVID, I relocated to the Albany/Rotterdam area and started over, applying the same hands-on approach that had worked in the city. That’s how Albany Airport Taxi (operating as US Limo and Taxi) was born, and we’ve been operating and expanding across the Capital Region, Hudson Valley, Adirondacks, and into Vermont and the Berkshires ever since.

What We Do Today

We provide door-to-door taxi, car, and SUV service to and from Albany International, JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, Boston Logan, and NYC, plus long-distance trips, courier deliveries, wedding guest shuttles, corporate transportation, and self-pay non-emergency medical transportation — with a mix of in-house and trusted independent local drivers across our 23-county service area. We also get people to and from the hotels, colleges, wineries, and attractions across the region.

Call us anytime, day or night, to book your ride or ask about rates.

title: Privacy Policy
detailHtml:
Dear customer, we would be glad if you could spare a minute or two to go through our privacy policy and terms of use. We assure you that we take great care of our customers' privacy, and that any personal information you share with us is kept safely and not shared with third parties.

Tracking traffic on our site

We use Google Analytics to track web traffic on our site. The only information we track is general location and site usage — user identities remain anonymous. We use this data only for internal reporting purposes.

Use of cookies and IP logging

Our site may use cookies or log IP addresses for security and anti-fraud purposes. These are standard practices used by most websites today. When you submit a request through our contact form, we may log your IP address to validate the request and prevent spam.

Spam protection

Our contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA to help prevent automated spam submissions. reCAPTCHA may collect information such as IP address and browser data, governed by Google's own Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Use of personal information

When you contact us through our website, we ask for information like your name, email, and phone number so we can respond to your request. This information remains private and is never shared with third parties.
